result.summary: Found 1 critical accessibility issue regarding text contrast on the promotional banner.

issues.description: The promotional banner ('3 free deliveries for you' and 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout • min. order €10') uses white text on a very light mint green background, resulting in extremely low contrast that makes the text difficult to read.
issues.suggestion: Change the banner text color to a dark shade (such as dark green or charcoal) or darken the background color of the banner to meet WCAG contrast requirements.
